'''Ajawa''' is an extinct [[Afro-Asiatic languages|Afro-Asiatic]] language formerly spoken in [[Bauchi State]], [[Nigeria]].  Ajawa became extinct between 1920 and 1940 as speakers switched to [[Hausa language|Hausa]].<ref name=e18/><ref>{{Cite book|title=An atlas of Nigerian languages|last=Blench|first=Roger|publisher=Kay Williamson Educational Foundation|year=2012|location=Cambridge, UK}}</ref>
